title: The truncation couple is an exact couple
statement:
Let $v:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ be left exact and additive
[def-sp-left-exact-additive] between Grothendieck abelian categories
[def-sp-grothendieck-abelian], and let $K\in\operatorname{Ch}^+(\mathcal A)$
be bounded below with $\mathcal H^q(K)=0$ for $q<a$. Then the truncation
couple [def-sp-truncation-couple] of $K$, with the structure maps $\alpha$,
$f$, $g$ of bidegrees $(-1,+1)$, $(+2,-1)$, $(0,0)$ of
[def-sp-truncation-couple], is an exact couple [def-sp-exact-couple].

proof.text: Instantiate [lem-sp-truncation-raw-exact] with the canonical standard derived-category instances for A and B. Its three clauses give exact short complexes for the raw truncation maps f-alpha, g-f (with zero-index equality transports), and alpha-g.
Unfold [def-sp-truncation-couple] and split the conjunction. The f-alpha clause is definitionally the first raw clause, so it is returned directly.

For the g-f and alpha-g clauses, transport the raw exact short complexes along the equality isomorphisms between the indexed objects. The local transport proof uses ShortComplex.isoMk and exact_of_iso, cancellation for the zero composite, and equality elimination plus integer arithmetic for the reindexed f, alpha, and g maps.

proof_origin.note: The proof is a direct reduction to truncation_raw_exact, followed by definitional unfolding and categorical equality transport. The prior four-step derived-functor route is subsumed by the proved raw exactness theorem.

split_report.summary: Statement kept. The one-step imported proof is split into four steps. Step 1 reads the structure maps off def-sp-truncation-couple (which names only f and the bidegrees): alpha = H^{p+q}(Rv i_{q+1}), g = H^{p+q}(Rv j_q), f = H^{p+q}(sigma o Rv k_q) followed by H^n(M[1]) = H^{n+1}(M), with the bidegrees (-1,+1), (0,0), (+2,-1) checked; it cites the truncation triangle lem-weil-pbc-truncation-triangle (silent in def-sp-truncation-couple) and notes that Rv must be the functor on D^+ of lem-weil-pbc-derived-direct-image-triangulated (k_q is not a chain map), equal on objects to the Rv of def-sp-kinjective-bridge, defined since Grothendieck categories have enough injectives. Step 2: Rv(T_q) distinguished (lem-weil-pbc-derived-direct-image-triangulated, Lean closed). Step 3: the long exact sequence by the Mathlib leaf lem-sf-derived-homology-long-exact (replacing lem-sp-long-exact-of-triangle, which would need a node for 'H^0 is homological'); its connecting map is H^n of the third map (Stacks 0148, no signs; Mathlib HomologySequence.δ = shiftMap of mor₃), i.e. f; sign conventions only change f by a unit. Step 4: the three identities of def-sp-exact-couple, the first one from the sequence of T_{q+1}, the other two from that of T_q (the imported text put all three at bidegree (p,q) of one sequence, which is off by one for ker alpha = im f). The hypothesis H^q(K)=0 for q<a is unused. Same argument as Step 2 of lem-weil-pbc-truncation-couple-morphism (for Phi = g^{-1}Rf_*, Psi = Rf'_*g'^{-1}); not duplicated. Not in Mathlib (no exact couples; three kinds of search recorded). No new nodes.

lean.statement: theorem truncationCouple_exact {A : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} A] [Abelian A] [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{v₁} A] {B : Type u₂} [Category.{v₂} B] [Abelian B] [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{v₂} B] (F : A ⥤ B) [F.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits F] (K : CochainComplex.Plus A) (a : ℤ) (ha : ∀ q : ℤ, q < a → IsZero (K.obj.homology q)) : (∀ p q : ℤ, ∃ w : (truncationCouple F K a ha).2.2.2.1 p q ≫ (truncationCouple F K a ha).2.2.1 (p + 2) (q - 1) = 0, (ShortComplex.mk _ _ w).Exact) ∧ (∀ p q : ℤ, ∃ w : (truncationCouple F K a ha).2.2.2.2 p q ≫ (truncationCouple F K a ha).2.2.2.1 p q = 0, (ShortComplex.mk _ _ w).Exact) ∧ (∀ p q : ℤ, ∃ w : (truncationCouple F K a ha).2.2.1 p q ≫ (truncationCouple F K a ha).2.2.2.2 (p - 1) (q + 1) = 0, (ShortComplex.mk _ _ w).Exact)

reviewed_lean.note: A,B Grothendieck abelian (IsGrothendieckAbelian, indep. universes); v additive+left exact = F.Additive+PreservesFiniteLimits; K : CochainComplex.Plus A; a, ha vanishing below a retained; conclusion: landed truncationCouple F K a ha components, zero composite + ShortComplex.Exact at D^{p+2,q-1} (f,alpha), E^{p,q} (g,f), D^{p-1,q+1} (alpha,g) for all p q in Z
